questions.explanation_english: Data sovereignty refers to the principle that data collected within a specific nation is subject to the governance and legal frameworks of that country. questions.question_english: Which term describes the automated processing system where artificial intelligence tools continuously assess student responses to adjust assessment question difficulty in real time?
options_english: Linear static testing
Rote memory evaluation
Computer Adaptive Testing (CAT)
Manual optical mark recognition
questions.explanation_english: Computer Adaptive Testing refers to an automated assessment system where algorithms continuously evaluate a student’s responses to select subsequent test questions. If a test-taker answers correctly, the platform presents a more challenging question, whereas incorrect answers trigger simpler items. This dynamic adjustment measures candidate proficiency accurately using fewer total questions compared to traditional static examinations, reducing testing time and optimizing evaluation precision.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। कंप्यूटर अनुकूलन परीक्षण एक स्वचालित मूल्यांकन प्रणाली को संदर्भित करता है जहाँ एल्गोरिदम लगातार छात्र की प्रतिक्रियाओं का मूल्यांकन करते हैं ताकि अगले परीक्षण प्रश्नों का चयन किया जा सके। यदि एक परीक्षणकर्ता सही उत्तर देता है, तो प्लेटफ़ॉर्म एक अधिक चुनौतीपूर्ण प्रश्न प्रस्तुत करता है, जबकि गलत उत्तर सरल प्रश्नों को सक्रिय करता है। यह गतिशील समायोजन उम्मीदवार की दक्षता को सटीकता से मापता है, पारंपरिक स्थिर परीक्षाओं की तुलना में कम कुल प्रश्नों का उपयोग करते हुए, परीक्षण समय को कम करता है और मूल्यांकन की सटीकता को अनुकूलित करता है।

questions.question_english: Which factor is recognized as a major structural cause of the digital divide in rural Indian education?
options_english: Over-saturation of high-speed fiber optic cables across isolated rural habitations and remote villages
Inadequate telecom infrastructure, erratic electricity supply, and low household income
Strict prohibition of educational software usage imposed by national education regulatory bodies

questions.explanation_english: The persistent digital divide in rural Indian education stems from structural socioeconomic and infrastructural constraints. Irregular electrical power, limited telecommunication tower coverage, and high broadband setup costs restrict digital network expansion in remote habitations. Additionally, lower average household income levels limit families’ ability to purchase smartphones, computers, and recurring data packages. These combined physical and financial constraints impede the seamless adoption of digital learning platforms across rural schools.

questions.question_english: What is “Edge Computing” and how does it relate to the Internet of Things (IoT)?
options_english: Storing all system data exclusively within a single centralized national repository facility
Processing data near its source to reduce latency and bandwidth usage in IoT networks
Printing numerical analytical data directly onto the outer edge margins of paper documents

questions.explanation_english: Edge computing is a decentralized computing architecture that processes data locally near its generation source, such as IoT sensors or edge microcontrollers, rather than transmitting raw data to distant centralized cloud servers. In IoT deployments, edge processing reduces network bandwidth consumption, lowers response latency, and maintains localized system functionality during temporary internet connectivity disruptions, optimizing real-time smart campus and municipal monitoring operations.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। एज संगणना एक विकेंद्रीकृत संगणकीय संरचना है जो डेटा को उसके उत्पादन स्रोत, जैसे IoT सेंसर या एज माइक्रोकंट्रोलर्स के निकट संसाधित करती है, बजाय इसके कि कच्चे डेटा को दूरस्थ केंद्रीकृत क्लाउड सर्वरों पर भेजा जाए। IoT तैनाती में, एज प्रसंस्करण नेटवर्क बैंडविड्थ खपत को कम करता है, प्रतिक्रिया विलंबता को घटाता है, और अस्थायी इंटरनेट कनेक्टिविटी बाधाओं के दौरान स्थानीयकृत प्रणाली कार्यक्षमता को बनाए रखता है, जो वास्तविक समय के स्मार्ट कैंपस और नगरपालिका निगरानी संचालन को अनुकूलित करता है।
